import json, collections
src = open('config.json', encoding='utf-8').read()
d = json.loads(src, object_pairs_hook=collections.OrderedDict)
d['service']['timeout'] = 45
d['service']['retries'] = 2
out = json.dumps(d, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n"
open('config-new.json', 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(out)
EOF

import json
a=json.load(open('config.json'));b=json.load(open('config-new.json'))
print('timeout',b['service']['timeout'],'retries',b['service']['retries'])

print('equal_except_changes',a==b)
